description: Bollinger Bands for a stock. A middle band (simple moving average of close) with upper and lower bands set a number of standard deviations above and below it. Bands widen when volatility rises and contract when it falls; price touching the upper/lower band is a common overbought/oversold cue. Includes %B ((close-lower)/(upper-lower)) and bandwidth ((upper-lower)/middle) columns. The moving-average window is warmed up on price history fetched before startDate, so values do not depend on the requested range's left edge.

endDate.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to latest available)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of records to return (default: 60, max: 500); the newest rows are kept and listed newest first.

startDate.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to 6 months ago)

stdDev.description: Standard deviations for the upper/lower bands (default: 2)

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT). Class shares use a dash (BRK-B); the dot form (BRK.B) is also accepted.

name: GetBollingerBands
title: Bollinger Bands
